Mount Rainier - actual terrain and tetrahedral model

Drag to rotate, or focus the canvas and use arrow keys. No vertical exaggeration.
Surface elevation, EGM2008

Geometry/material view of the completed exploratory CPU/MPI model. The six effective regions are modelling assumptions, not measured geology. Lines on side/cut faces are real tetrahedral mesh edges; terrain-following interfaces are not mapped geological contacts.

Terrain source: Microsoft Planetary Computer Copernicus GLO-30 DSM, not a bare-earth DTM. The available 3DEP tiles do not cover the summit/domain. No products or vertical datums were mixed. Glacier/ice, vegetation and infrastructure are represented as an effective surface, not separate media. Main satellite acquisition 2011-2015; exact local acquisition dates are not supplied by this MPC tile.

Surface stations R01-R10 are deterministic random XY locations, seed 20261120, at least 500 m from lateral edges. Their elevations are on the actual model triangles, not the unmeshed DSM. Station markers/labels are overlaid for visibility; stations outside the retained cutaway half are hidden.
